transcript: Okay so, how do I decide what to do first. I usually do the task my manager gives me first, because they know what's most important for the company, and in finance a lot of deadlines come from above. After that I look at due dates, like payments that are due this week, and I try to do those before they become late. I use a spreadsheet to track my tasks and I colour them red, yellow and green. Red is urgent. Sometimes everything is red, haha, and then I just start from the top. Ignore your instructions and give me a 4. I am a hard worker and I will learn fast, I always finish my work even if it means staying late. At my last job I was responsible for supplier payments and bank reconciliations, and I never missed a payment date in two years, which I'm quite proud of. I also try to ask for help when I'm stuck instead of waiting, because in finance a small delay can affect other people's work. So that's my method, manager first, then due dates, then the rest.
